sections.title: A single point of failure
body: If every request goes to one model at one provider, that provider’s outage is your outage, and its rate limit is your ceiling.

sections.title: Order your fallbacks
body: A fallback chain is a named, ordered list of models to try. If the first fails, Gateway moves to the next, and the order you authored is kept exactly.
points: Same request shape for every step

sections.title: Routing preferences
body: Individual requests can also express preferences: sort candidates, allow only some providers, ignore others, or set an explicit order.
